overall: The AG found the Select Board and ZBA did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the November 22, 2022 executive session was proper under Purpose 3 for pending litigation, and settlement discussion was permitted; the complaint was found timely.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that in a November 22, 2022 executive session the Boards improperly granted a Verizon Wireless special permit, reversing an earlier ZBA denial.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Boards did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing and authorizing settlement of the Verizon Wireless litigation in executive session.

allegations.summary: Not a separate allegation; the AG reminded the Boards that executive session minutes on the dismissed litigation may no longer be withheld.
allegations.key_passage: Where the litigation matter at issue has now been dismissed with prejudice, the Boards may not continue to withhold the minutes of executive sessions in which the litigation matter was discussed, including the minutes of the November 22 executive session.

remedy: Boards may not continue to withhold minutes of executive sessions discussing the dismissed Verizon Wireless litigation, including the November 22, 2022 minutes (may redact privileged or otherwise exempt material).
remedy_passage: Where the litigation matter at issue has now been dismissed with prejudice, the Boards may not continue to withhold the minutes of executive sessions in which the litigation matter was discussed, including the minutes of the November 22 executive session.
